results.text: Microsoft spans the computer on your desk and the services behind your work. Windows runs the PC experience. Microsoft 365 supports documents, communication, and collaboration. Azure supplies cloud computing, storage, and AI services for applications. Copilot adds AI assistance across selected workflows. These are connected products, not a single system: what you can use depends on the product, configuration, and subscription.
